The '''Timour Lines fuel depot''' was located on [[Grande Hyet]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. The [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] depot was destroyed in a [[Terrorist attacks on Esseles|terrorist attack]] by the [[Faceless]], causing [[Timour Lines]]' stock to plummet.
